description: Remove the full-page background image while preserving the hero image, and restore readable dark text in the quick-answer box.

replacements.old: body { margin:0; background-color:#0f1116; background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(11,13,16,0.3),rgba(11,13,16,0.7)),url('/static/cullen_house.jpg'); background-size:cover; background-position:center; background-attachment:scroll; color:#d1d7e0; font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif; line-height:1.8; overflow-x:hidden; }
replacements.new: body { margin:0; background-color:#0f1116; background-image:none; color:#d1d7e0; font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif; line-height:1.8; overflow-x:hidden; }
